area: Federal compliance profiles, one compliance choice and the compliance pack: ZIA security baseline, AI Guard detection policy, policy packs (IRS 1075 FTI Pack), the Compliance page, the POV planner and Simple mode
title: Six federal profiles with sourced control catalogues that change rules where the source justifies it, every created rule mapped to a control or a reason code, and local compliance pack exports with synthetic DLP test data

checks.what: Every ZIA baseline catalog rule, ATP setting and offered pack rule maps rule -> objective -> the profile's controls or carries a reason code, for all 15 profiles and four tiers; a gap raises

Federal profiles build on Strict and change rules only where cited: FedRAMP High requires the SSL catch-all, QUIC and password-protected archive blocks (AC-4(4)) and drops the SSL exemptions; CMMC L2 and IRS 1075 add the translation block; IRS 1075 requires the webmail block; Federal ZT requires DoH inspection and the Trusted Resolver; GovRAMP equals FedRAMP Moderate
A profile build is previewed, applied disabled through the shared engine and recorded with its profile; the pack made from the recorded run says what was built
Synthetic DLP files hold only reserved SSNs, published test card numbers and example.com addresses, start with SYNTHETIC TEST DATA and say whether the engine should fire
The engine evaluator only evaluates numbers, comparisons and and/or/not after every dictionary name became a count
Compliance pack routes need the UI token, refuse a cross-origin POST, serve no-store nosniff attachments and refuse unknown profiles, files and recorded runs with a 4xx
Baseline form with a profile, the AI Guard form following it, the Compliance page profile view and Simple mode's preset in headless Chrome; no sideways scroll at 320px

findings.title: The compliance profile select and the profile view's select overflowed a 320px viewport (long profile names widened the fieldset)
findings.fix: The selects are capped at the container width and the block stacks vertically.

findings.title: The existing assessment mapping (compliance_mapping.CONTROL_DOMAINS CMMC_L2, ssl_inspection) credits TLS inspection to SC.L2-3.13.8 and SC.L2-3.13.16 (protection of CUI in transit and at rest), which inspection does not carry out; the ZIA baseline's SP 800-171 overlay source says Rev. 3 while its ids are Rev. 2
findings.reason: Left as it is to keep the 13-framework assessment contract unchanged in this branch; the new federal profiles do not reuse these mappings (CMMC Level 2 credits inspection to SI.L2-3.14.6 only).
